stemBlocks: A uniform rod XY of length $3.0 \text{ m}$ has a weight of $20 \text{ N}$. The rod is supported by two light wires, P and Q, as shown. P and Q are attached $0.50 \text{ m}$ from ends X and Y, respectively. A $40 \text{ N}$ load is moved from end X to end Y. The rod remains horizontal at all times.
Which graph shows the variation of the tension $T$ in wire P with the position of the load as it is moved along the rod?
